title: Company itself is on the sanctions list

referral.merchant_message: Wholesale order of £880 declined, please advise.

steps.text: I'll start by looking up the merchant, the transaction, and any earlier referrals — all in parallel.
Good, I have the merchant and transaction details. Now let me run the sanctions screens for both the merchant name and owner name, and check the card status.

The sanctions screening for the merchant name "Orion Trading Ltd" returned a match score of 1.0 (≥ 0.85 threshold). Per policy, this must be escalated to the financial crime team immediately, and the reason must not be disclosed to the merchant.
